heading: AOT code load errors (-550 .. -599)
text:
### AOT code load errors (-550 .. -599) [IERR.2.8b]

The band is the ahead-of-time `CompiledCode` loader's ([RAOT.9]). Its codes,
-550 to -553, are reserved and never reused: in this edition libds skips every
`CompiledCode` atom and decodes none ([RDSC.4c.3]), so nothing returns them.
The band stays claimed for that loader, and a code it needs when compiled code
binds takes a new number in it.
